n, m = list(map(int, input().split()))

ady = [[] for i in range(n)]
vis = [False for i in range(n)]

for _ in range(m):
    u, v = list(map(int, input().split()))
    ady[u-1].append(v-1)
    ady[v-1].append(u-1)

par = [len(ady[i]) == 2 for i in range(n)]


def dfs(x):
    global ady, vis
    if vis[x]:
        return par[x]
    vis[x] = True
    r = par[x]
    for i in ady[x]:
        r = r and dfs(i)
        vis[i] = True

    return r

    if not vis[i]:
        res = dfs(i)
        if res:
            r += 1

n = int(input())

nums = [int(x) for x in input().split()]

n = len(nums)
dp = [0]*n
seen = {}

for i in range(n):
    num = nums[i]
    if num-1 in seen:
        idx = seen[num-1]
        dp[i] = 1 + dp[idx]
    else:
        dp[i] = 1
    
    seen[num] = i

mmax = 0
high = -1
for i in range(n):
    if dp[i] > mmax:
        mmax = dp[i]
        high = nums[i]

idxs = []
cur = low
for i in range(n):
    if len(idxs) == mmax:
        break
    x = nums[i]
    if x == cur:
        cur+=1
        idxs.append(i+1)
